q: Predictive coding and the entropy rate are connected through the fact that the optimal predictor of Xₙ given X₁,...,Xₙ₋₁ achieves an average log-loss of:
opts: H̄ (the entropy rate) in the limit
exp: The conditional entropy H(Xₙ|X₁,...,Xₙ₋₁) → H̄ for stationary ergodic processes. The optimal predictor's log-loss equals the conditional entropy, so long-run prediction difficulty equals the entropy rate.
